settings.heading: Application Tips from the JOSS Cosmetics Team
Body Tanning Cream
settings.description:
1. Skin preparation. Our formula works beautifully even without special rituals.

(Optionally, 10–12 hours before application, you may do a gentle scrub and moisturize the skin — especially on dry areas.)

2. Shake the bottle to ensure the formula is perfectly blended.

3. Apply the cream in a sufficient amount to clean, dry skin. Place small dots over the body and spread it right away across larger areas for a smooth, even result.

4. Perfect result
One layer is enough to create a beautiful, rich effect. Multiple layers are not recommended.

settings.text:
✨ Intensive effect (Latin look)
Apply with clean hands or in nitrile gloves to achieve a deep, saturated tone.

✨ Delicate effect (Balroom / 10-dance / Juniors)
Use a special tanning mitt for a soft, even finish that delivers a natural shade without harsh transitions.

settings.heading: Liquid Bronzer
settings.description:
1. Shake well before use to ensure an even texture.
2. Choose your preferred application method:

• by hand with protective rubber gloves

• with a special soft tanning mitt for bronzers/self-tanners

3. Pour the bronzer into your palm or directly onto the body and spread it quickly and evenly. Pay extra attention to areas where the product may accumulate.

4. Adjust the color intensity with layers — apply one or two. For the most intense effect, we recommend applying two layers with rubber gloves.

settings.text:
• Special soft mitt — super light effect

• Rubber gloves — medium effect

• Rubber gloves + two layers — maximum intense effect

settings.heading: Sparkling loose powder
settings.description:
For the best results, use the powder as the final touch after applying your base products (Body Tanning Cream or Liquid Bronzer):

1. Prepare your skin — apply a dark base (Body Tanning Cream or Liquid Bronzer) all over the body.

2. Apply the powder immediately after the base, while the skin is still slightly damp. This ensures better fixation.

3. Control the amount of product depending on the desired effect — from a delicate glow to an intense stage shine.

4. Use a large soft brush with dense hair. It will help distribute the product quickly and evenly without fallout. The perfect choice is the JOSS brush.

5. Leave the products on the skin for 15–20 minutes to let them settle and lock in place.

settings.heading: Perfect Removal Routine
settings.description:
To gently and effectively remove your tanning products while keeping your skin smooth and healthy, follow these steps:

  1. Begin with warm water — allow the skin to soften and the product to loosen naturally.
  2. Cleanse delicately — use a mild shower gel or soap, avoiding harsh scrubbing to protect your skin.
  3. Use a soft sponge or cloth — massage in gentle circular motions for an even and effortless removal.
  4. Repeat if needed — deeper tones or layered applications may require a second cleanse.
  5. Hydrate your skin — finish with a nourishing lotion or oil to restore softness and glow.
